{{Short description|French biologist and parasitologist (1935–2021)}}
[[File:Claude.Combes.png|thumb|Claude Combes]]
'''Claude Combes''' (22 July 1935 – 8 July 2021) was a French biologist and [[Parasitology|parasitologist]]. He was a professor of animal biology and director of the Centre de Biologie et Écologie Tropicale et Méditerranéenne at the [[Université de Perpignan]].

Combes got his aggregation of natural sciences in 1958 and a doctoral degree in 1967.

He received several scientific awards including the [[CNRS Silver Medal]] (1986), Skryabin Medal (USSR Academy of Sciences) (1991), Philip Morris Research Prize (1990).

Combes was a member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] from 1996. He died on 8 July 2021, at the age of 85.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Pyrénées-Orientales : Le monde scientifique pleure la disparition du grand biologiste et parasitologue catalan Claude Combes |url=https://www.lindependant.fr/2021/07/14/pyrenees-orientales-le-monde-scientifique-pleure-la-disparition-du-grand-biologiste-et-parasitologue-catalan-claude-combes-9671651.php |access-date=2026-09-18 |website=lindependant.fr |language=fr}}</ref>

== Books ==
* ''La Vie'', 2002 Ellipses (L'esprit des sciences)
* ''Taxonomie, écologie et évolution des métazoaires parasites''. (Taxonomy, ecology and evolution of metazoan parasites), 2003 PUP
* ''The Art of Being a Parasite'', 2005 The University of Chicago Press (2003 in French)
* ''Encyclopedic Reference of Parasitology'', (2nd edition, 38 co-authors), 2002 Springer
* ''Interactions durables. Ecologie et évolution du parasitisme'', 1995 Masson (Ecologie, 26)
* ''L'homme et l'animal. De Lascaux à la vache folle'', 1999 Belin (Pour la Science)
* ''Les associations du vivant : l'art d'être parasite'', 2001 Flammarion
* ''Parasitism. The Ecology and Evolution of Intimate Interactions''. 2001 University of Chicago Press

== Honors and awards ==

* Knight of the [[Ordre national du Mérite|Ordre National du Mérite]] (1986)
* Knight of the [[Legion of Honour|Order of Legion of Honour]] (1991)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Pyrénées-Orientales : Le monde scientifique pleure la disparition du grand biologiste et parasitologue catalan Claude Combes |url=https://www.lindependant.fr/2021/07/14/pyrenees-orientales-le-monde-scientifique-pleure-la-disparition-du-grand-biologiste-et-parasitologue-catalan-claude-combes-9671651.php |access-date=2026-10-12 |website=lindependant.fr |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=1999-01-03 |title=Légion d'honneur |url=https://www.lemonde.fr/archives/article/1999/01/03/legion-d-honneur_3529721_1819218.html |access-date=2026-10-12 |work=Le Monde |language=fr |issn=1950-6244}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Claude COMBES {{!}} Académie d'Agriculture de France |url=https://www.academie-agriculture.fr/membres/annuaire/claude-combes |access-date=2026-10-12 |website=www.academie-agriculture.fr}}</ref>
